note: Carried in pick_price (Yard.lean): off_label does the reflection, fan_out the finite parity projection, and exterior_size (Vanishing.lean) the scaled-profile estimates. [L] states the support/Laplace-factor input as a frequency-support condition on the profile's transform (pose_far, hf in track_sale), and its bounds are Budget exponents, not explicit constants.

lemma off_label (B A : Weight L) (H : S.Hierarchy) (a b l d : Axis) (h : d≠a)
    (k : Axis) (f : Bool) (hf : Own B k f) (hh : Own A k (spar d b k)) (hp : f≠spar a b k) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ q, readsCluster S B A q * positionTest (tracks (chart a b l) d n (canvas (shiftPlot d (orchard a)))) q)=0 := by
  let z (q : E4) := readsCluster S B A q * positionTest (tracks (chart a b l) d n (canvas (shiftPlot d (orchard a)))) q
  let K := Ortho.motion (Signed.reflect k)
  have hm (q : E4) : z (K q)= -z q := by
    have hu : signValue f*signValue (spar d b k)*signValue (spar a d k)=-1 := by
      have he (x y z f : Bool) (hp : f≠ Bool.xor x y) : signValue f*signValue (Bool.xor z y)*signValue (Bool.xor x z)=-1 := by
        cases x <;> cases y <;> cases z <;> cases f <;> simp_all [signValue]
      exact he _ _ _ _ hp
    unfold z; rw [show K q=Ortho.move _ q from rfl,reads_mirror S H.spin k B A f _ hf hh,pose_sign a b l d k h]
    simp only [← mul_assoc] at *; rw [mul_right_comm _ (readsCluster _ _ _ q),hu]; simp
  have ht : (∫ q,z q)= -(∫ q, z q) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← K.measurePreserving.integral_comp K.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]
    simp_rw [hm,integral_neg]
  have hp : 2*(∫ q,z q)=0 := by
    rw [two_mul]; conv_lhs => lhs; rw [ht]
    exact neg_add_cancel _
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left (by norm_num)

proof_context.conclusion: Reflecting the integration variable in an axis k makes the integral vanish for every sign component of the spectator weight with the wrong parity in k.

lemma pick_price (a b l d : Axis) (hd : d≠a) (hh : a≠b) (P : DiffPlan S) (hP : P.Derivatives S) (H : S.Hierarchy) (hi : P.Orientation H.spin) (J : Stress S) (hr : RawTensor H.spin J) (C : Conserved P H.spin J) (B : Weight L)
    (hu : ∀ i∈other l,Pressed i B) :
    let T n := fun q : E4 => readsCluster S B (pick (J d b)) q * Complex.ofReal (Analysis.D (basis d) (petal a b l n) q)
    (∀ᶠ n in atTop, Integrable (T n)) ∧ Budget (-1) (fun n => ∫ q, T n q) := by
  intro T
  let V i := Classical.choice (realization H i)
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hx,ht⟩ := enters_weights H _ _ (shines J H hr d b)
  let f := canvas (shiftPlot d (orchard a)); have hf : ∀ p : ℝ,hat (f d) p≠0 → 1≤|p| := pose_far a d hd
  let R (B : Weight L) n := fun q : E4 => readsCluster S B A q * positionTest (tracks (chart a b l) d n f) q
  let D (B : Weight L) := (∀ᶠ n in atTop, Integrable (R B n)) ∧ Budget (-101) (fun n => integral volume (R B n))
  have hp : D B := by
    refine fan_out l D (fun U C H h => ?_) (fun B h e H' => ?_) B hu
    · have he (n : ℕ) q : R (U+C) n q=R U n q+R C n q := by unfold R; rw [reads_add_l,add_mul]
      rcases H with ⟨hI,hU⟩; rcases h with ⟨hj,hj'⟩
      refine ⟨?_, (hU.add hj').same ?_⟩
      · filter_upwards [hI,hj] with n hv ht; rw [funext (he n)]; exact hv.add ht
      filter_upwards [hI,hj] with n hv ht; rw [funext (he n),integral_add hv ht]
    have hk : chart a b l d < 0 := (chart_bounds a b l d).2.trans_lt (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨(track_sale _ d (V d) H B A _ _ (H' _) (hx _) f hk hf).mono fun _ H => H.1,?_⟩
    by_cases hz : e=spar a b
    · subst e
      exact exterior_size a b l d hd hh P hP V H hi J hr C B A hA H' h hx ht f hf
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz
    exact (no_budget (X:=ℂ) (-101)).same (.of_forall fun n => (off_label B A H a b l d hd k _ (H' _) (hx _) hk n).symm)
  have he n : T n= fun q => (fuel 100 n:ℂ) * R B n q := by
    ext1 q; unfold T R; rw [hA.1,track_pose,mul_left_comm]
  rcases hp with ⟨h,h'⟩
  simp_rw [he]; exact ⟨h.mono fun n hn => hn.const_mul _, (((budget_fuel 100).of_r.prod h').rise (le_of_eq (by ring))).same
    (.of_forall fun n => (integral_const_mul ..).symm)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For d≠a, splits the collinear spectator weight into sign components (fan_out), kills the wrong-parity ones by off_label, bounds the remaining one by exterior_size (Budget -101) and multiplies by the prefactor fuel 100 to get Budget -1.

lemma exterior_size (a b l d : Axis) (hd : d≠a) (hh : a≠b) (P : DiffPlan S) (hP : P.Derivatives S) (V : ∀ i, Chamber S i) (H : S.Hierarchy) (hi : P.Orientation H.spin)
    (J : Stress S) (hr : RawTensor H.spin J) (C : Conserved P H.spin J) (B A : Weight L) (he : equalRead S A (pick (J d b)))
    (hB : ∀ i,Own B i (spar a b i)) (hu : ∀ i∈other l,Pressed i B) (hA : ∀ i,Own A i (spar d b i)) (hg : ∀ i,Pressed i A)
    (f : Panels) (hf : ∀ p : ℝ,hat (f d) p≠0 → 1≤|p|) :
    Budget (-101) (fun n => ∫ q, readsCluster S B A q * positionTest (tracks (chart a b l) d n f) q) := by
  let w := chart a b l; let e := signValue (spar a b d)*signValue (spar d b d)
  have hk i := chart_bounds a b l i
  change ∀ i,-300≤w i ∧ w i ≤ -100 at hk
  have hw i : w i < 0 := lt_of_le_of_lt (hk i).2 (by norm_num)
  have hj : ‖e‖=1 := by unfold e; rw [norm_mul]; cases spar a b d <;> cases spar d b d <;> simp [signValue]
  have hy := track_sale w d (V d) H B A _ _ (hB d) (hA d) f (hw d) hf
  have hz := ice w d (V d) H B A f hf 300 (fun i => (hk i).1) (hw d) e hj (-101)
  have hl := mixesLine a b l hh
  have hW i : 1+w i ≤ 0 := by linarith [(hk i).2]
  have hG : Colors Finset.univ (fun _ => center) := fun _ _ => ⟨center_ends,center_plus,center_even⟩
  let u := if d=l then (1:ℝ) else -(1+w l)+1
  let X := jar w d f e
  have hX : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, fits (V d) B A (X n) := hy.mono fun n hn j => (hn.2.1 j).indicator (cove_m ..)
  let T := due w d (-3000)
  have hT : Budget u (fun n => integral (ν (V d) B) (T n)) := line_cost V H l _ B hB hl.1 hl.2 hu d (fun i => 1+w i) hW 1 (-3000) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ hG
  have hY n : Integrable (T n) (ν (V d) B) := cost_int V d B _ (fuel_pos ..) _ _
  have ht : u≤150 := by
    have he : -150 ≤ w l := chart_here ..; unfold u; split_ifs <;> linarith
  have hp : Budget (-101) (fun n => cross (V d) B A (X n)) := by
    by_cases hc:d=b
    · subst b
      have hA : Own A d false := by simpa [spar] using hA d
      have hD : w d= -100 := chart_there ..
      let z := fun n => coneWeight d (fuel (-99) n) (homes w n)
      obtain ⟨hm,hs⟩ := mass V H J P hP hi hr C d A he hA (hg d) (fun i => 1+w i) (-99) (by norm_num)
        (fun i _ => by linarith [(hk i).2]) _ hG 1 (by norm_num)

proof_context.conclusion: Bounds the right-parity component using the Fourier-scaled profiles (track_sale), a profile transform supported where |p|≥1 (pose_far), line_cost and mass, giving Budget -101.
